description: Scan HV (USB-231 DAC split mode -> Trek 609E-6 x1000) measured on the bench with cls-cal through the KV-10A 1000:1 divider and a Keysight 34465A. Gain 0.99887 (stable to ~5 ppm over 12 h), offset about -0.9 V drifting ~0.1 V over hours, and a reproducible DAC nonlinearity of ~0.25 V rms. Built for the Bi offline experiment, October 2026.
